objective.text: Set an overlap-lock expiration to recover after a worker crashes before releasing it.

difficulty.rationale: Recover a lock left by an ungraceful process death without expiring it during valid processing.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A worker can be killed before its overlap middleware’s finally block releases a lock. Legitimate processing has a measured upper bound. Which setting limits the orphan lock lifetime, with a duration chosen beyond valid processing time?

options.text: A longer queue name containing the expected duration.
options.rationale: A logical queue label does not configure cache lock expiration.
options.misconception: A logical queue label does not configure cache lock expiration.

options.rationale: This delays a job that failed to acquire the lock; it does not expire the lock held by the dead worker.
options.misconception: This delays a job that failed to acquire the lock; it does not expire the lock held by the dead worker.

options.rationale: This discards a contending job rather than repairing the orphaned lock’s lifetime.
options.misconception: This discards a contending job rather than repairing the orphaned lock’s lifetime.

options.rationale: This supplies a lock TTL so an abandoned lock can eventually be acquired again; sizing must avoid expiry during legitimate work.
